category.subtitle: Subtitle
error.bad_options: an option is out of range
error.cancelled: the job ran out of time
error.engine_missing: needs an engine this server does not have
error.office_missing: office documents need ONLYOFFICE, which is not connected to this server
error.too_large: file too large for this conversion
option.at.help: The moment the single frame is taken from.
option.at.label: Frame at (seconds)
option.bitrate.help: How much room the sound gets: 192 is plenty for music, 320 is as good as this format gets, and the file grows with it.
option.bitrate.label: Audio bitrate
option.crf.help: 0-51; lower is better quality and larger. 18-28 is the usual range.
option.crf.label: Video quality (CRF)
option.dpi.help: How finely the page is drawn: 150 is sharp on a screen, 300 is sharp on paper, and the image grows with it.
option.dpi.label: Resolution (dpi)
option.duration.help: How long the still image plays.
option.duration.label: Duration (seconds)
option.every.help: 0 = one frame only; otherwise one image every N seconds (at most 64).
option.every.label: A frame every (seconds)
option.icon_sizes.help: An .ico file holds the same picture at several sizes; this says which ones go in. A browser tab needs the small three, a desktop application the whole set.
option.icon_sizes.label: Icon sizes
option.max_height.help: 0 keeps the original size; otherwise scale down to this height.
option.max_height.label: Max height (px)
option.merge.help: All selected files become one output (pages of one PDF, frames of one video, members of one archive).
option.merge.label: Combine into one file
option.merge.yes: One file for all of them
option.pages.help: Empty = all pages; otherwise a range such as 1-3 or 2.
option.pages.label: Pages
option.pdfa.help: PDF/A packs everything the page needs into the file, so it still opens the same way years from now. It gets bigger in return.
option.pdfa.label: PDF/A (archival)
option.picture.help: What the audio is drawn as.
option.picture.label: Picture
option.preset.help: Size against quality: the slower the setting, the harder the file is squeezed. Every button says what it costs.
option.preset.label: Preset
option.quality.label: Quality
validate.pages: Use a page or a range such as 1-3.
validate.pick: Pick one of the listed values.
view.blocked.intro: Not available on this server (engine missing):
view.chosen: Chosen: {format}. Press another format to change it, or Next to carry on.
view.combine_body: The {n} files you picked can become a single {format}, or {n} separate ones.
view.combine_heading: One file, or one for each?
view.no_common_target: These files share no target format.
view.no_engines: No conversion is possible with the engines installed on this server.
view.office_not_connected: Office documents are converted by ONLYOFFICE, and none is connected to this server. An administrator connects it under External services.
view.where.choose: Choose a folder for the result.
view.where.heading: Where should the result go?
view.where.why: The selected files are on a read-only storage, so the result cannot be saved beside them. Choose a folder for it.
